descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92593 AC 3 · “Answers are scoped strictly to that patient's existing data, with no cross-patient bleed”. Mixed: stated part — After opening another patient, Ask answers from that patient only; our part — Ask answering from the just-saved note edit (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S26 Ask through the real Post-Round sheet: after Save Edits it answers from the edited note; after opening another patient it answers from that patient only

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two Hospital patients under one physician, both note-ready: A with note N-H, B with a CHF note (furosemide, echo)

When A: Edit Note, add 'QA-ASK-EDIT start metoprolol 12.5 mg PO BID', Save Edits, open 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient', tap the preset 'What's in the plan section?' (cp1). Open B without reloading, open Ask, the same preset (cp2). Back on A: Encounter tab, Ask, type 'What's in the plan section?' (cp3)

Then A's Post-Round answer includes metoprolol (the saved edit). B's answer includes furosemide and the echo and nothing from A (no ceftriaxone, no metoprolol, not A's name). A's Encounter-tab answer is recorded beside the Post-Round one

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint, scoped to the Ask dialog (RG-SCOPE): the note behind the sheet holds the same words, so a page-wide mustContain would pass without the answer. The negatives on cp2 also hold page-wide. reqs [T10] (TFA-92593 AC 3, ready for qa) is ungated, so stale context reports as Fail. cp3 is recorded and judged against U2 once Q4 is answered

Where it ran: dev unit U32; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)
